desc.Whitties: You take two cookies, you put some custard in between
desc.Shakes: Take our custard, add some milk and mix in a few toppings
desc.Sundaes: Take a scoop or two of one of our flavors and add your favorite toppings on top
desc.Floats: Our vanilla custard mixed in with a soda of your choice
desc.Vanilla Custard: Ingredients: skim milk, grade "a" cream, sugar, non fat milk solids, egg yolks, corn syrup, whey solids
desc.Chocolate Custard: Ingredients: milk, cream, non fat milk solids, sugar, corn syrup, cocoa, whey solids, egg yolk solids
